items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Billy was a fine musician. Everybody knew he was a fine singer. But, he played the valve trombone with the best.

ctx.x: Your slick, your really slick. You know that. (Laughs) Billy Eckstein Big Band?
Billy was a fine musician. Everybody knew he was a fine singer. But, he played the valve trombone with the best.
Didn’t you do a record where he was playing valve trombone? When I scroll through here, I’m going to find it.
